verdict.rationale: Dover's docs describe a first-party Dover API for adding candidates, listing hires, and hosting a custom careers page, so a public API exists and is documented. Its stated scope is narrow compared with the rest of the platform (outreach, scheduling, feedback, CRM), and probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the usual paths. missing for 10: API coverage beyond candidates/hires/careers page (e.g. scheduling, feedback, outreach), a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, auth and reference details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Add candidates, list hires, and host a custom careers page with the Dover API.
